prefs.hint: Choose how Kiorex may contact you and what it may measure. Service messages about your visits always reach you.

prefs.capsNote: At most {{day}} marketing message a day and {{week}} a week, across all channels.
prefs.unsubscribed: You are unsubscribed from all marketing.
prefs.classesTitle: What each kind of message is
prefs.classesBody: Kiorex sends four kinds of message. Three are part of the service and always reach you; only marketing is your choice.

TRANSACTIONAL.name: Service
TRANSACTIONAL.body: About your bookings, deposits, receipts and rewards you already have. Needed to run your visit.

SECURITY.name: Security
SECURITY.body: A new device opened your account, or a sign-in code. Sent at once, any hour.

CLINICAL.name: Care
CLINICAL.body: Something about your care that cannot wait, like a safety notice. Urgent ones can reach you in quiet hours.

MARKETING.name: Marketing
MARKETING.body: News, offers and invitations. Only on the channels you switch on, never in your quiet hours, never more than the limit below, and you can stop all of it in one tap.

corporate.title: Company benefit
corporate.hint: If your employer offers a Kiorex benefit, join with the code you were given.
corporate.codeHelp: Letters and numbers only. Dashes and spaces are ignored.
corporate.orEmail: No code? If your company e-mail address is verified in your Kiorex account, you can join without one.
corporate.how: The benefit reduces the deposit of a booking when you pay it, up to your allowance. It has no cash value and cannot be transferred, gifted or withdrawn.
corporate.privacy: Your employer never sees who joined, who you book or why. They receive anonymous totals only, and only for groups of 10 people or more.
corporate.leaveHint: You stop being eligible at once. Bookings that already used the benefit are not changed.
corporate.terms: Programme terms and your data rights are shown here once counsel has approved the wording.
